title: Conditional bounded-degree graph history and two-orientation envelope
question: Does a finite open-box graph with maximum degree six admit a volume-independent oriented-walk and adjoint history envelope for a supplied two-orientation recurrence?

model.graph: finite open boxes in Z^3 with side lengths in the declared fixture
model.path_bound: the number of length-m walks from any seed is at most 6^m, independent of site_count
model.adjoint_bound: the reversed undirected graph has the same path envelope
model.scope: conditional graph combinatorics and branch algebra; the Q3 recurrence is not supplied

scoped_verdict: For all tested open boxes with sides 1 through 4, every seed and order through five, exact path counts and their reverse-orientation counts obey the 6^m bound and agree. The supplied branch recurrence has factor 37/35 at each step and iterated factor (37/35)^5. These are volume-independent conditional graph bounds, not the Q3 operator history theorem.
open_after_test: derive the actual Q3 onsite-plus-bond common-core recurrence
control source coefficients and cancellations rather than only path counts
prove all finite exhaustion shapes, not only the tested box family
establish common alpha and exhaustion Cauchy
construct KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum, C6 and Pre-A bridges

adversarial_review.check: The 6^m count bounds combinatorial walks only; it does not bound the actual Q3 commutator coefficient or source norm.
Sides 1 through 4 are tested; arbitrary finite shapes and the exhaustion limit are not claimed.
Reverse equality uses the explicitly undirected box graph; it does not supply the Q3 adjoint history identity.
R218 checks degree and scalar branch arithmetic only; it does not formalize path enumeration or the Q3 recurrence.
No thermodynamic dynamics, KMS state, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion is supplied.

scope.closed: Conditional bounded-degree path and reverse-orientation envelope for the declared finite open-box family, plus the supplied two-orientation branch algebra.
scope.not_closed: Actual Q3 recurrence, source coefficient control, arbitrary exhaustion shapes, exhaustion Cauchy, common alpha, KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Use the bounded-degree result only as a coefficient-count input; derive the actual Q3 common-core source recurrence and repeat the estimate with all shapes and both orientations before any common-alpha or QFT promotion.
no_overclaim: This package is a conditional graph-history checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
